P.name: Unseen Predator
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon casting a {{tip|Champion ability|basic ability}} or using ''{{ais|Savagery|Rengar}}'' first attack, '''Rengar''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} for {{tt|1 second|counting from the end of attack windup or cast time}}, stacking up 4 times but not refreshing on subsequent triggers {{bug|2}}. At maximum stacks, his next basic ability consumes them all to become empowered with an additional effect and grant him an additional cast along with {{sti|ms|{{pp|key=%|30 to 50 for 3|1 to 13|color=ms}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Generated {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} is prevented from expiring for 10 seconds after dealing or taking damage, excluding damage dealt by [[damage over time]] or [[Damage#Engine_level|proc]] effects.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} While in {{tip|brush}}, '''Rengar''' gains ''Unseen Predator'', which lingers for {{fd|0.35}} seconds upon exiting brush. ''Unseen Predator'' is lost immediately if '''Rengar''' exits the brush using {{si|Flash}} or {{si|Hexflash}}.
P.description3:
{{sbc|Unseen Predator:}} '''Rengar's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-attack}} generates {{as|1 Ferocity|buzzword3}} if none of his {{tt|{{as|current Ferocity|buzzword3}} was generated this way|The next use of Unseen Predator after consuming all Ferocity from an empowered ability will count for this effect}}. The attack also has massively increased range and causes him to {{tip|dash|leap}} to the target's location if they are beyond his normal basic attack range, attacking the target upon arrival and landing 50 units in front of them.

'''''Rengar''' can cast any of his abilities during the dash. The start of the leap is the end of '''Rengar's''' {{tip|attack windup}}, putting the attack timer on cooldown, triggering {{tip|on-attack}} effects and additionally refreshing the {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} duration.''
P.description4: {{Anchor|Bonetooth Necklace}}{{sbc|Innate - Bonetooth Necklace:}} Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} within 3 seconds of damaging them grants '''Rengar''' a ''Trophy'', once per unique champion and up to 5. An additional ''Trophy'' is made available through the event ''[[The Hunt is On!]]'' with the [[File:Head of Kha'Zix.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Head of Kha'Zix''. ''Trophies'' grant {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{pp|type=[[File:Bonetooth Necklace.png|20px|border|adjustsize|link=]] Trophies|key=%|x^2 for 6|x;Head of Kha'Zix|formula=(Number of Trophies) * (Number of Trophies)}} '''bonus''' AD}}.

Q.name: Savagery
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rengar''' gains {{sti|{{as|40% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} on his next two {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} within 3 seconds.
Q.description2: His first attack {{tip|on-hit}} is empowered to stab the target, having an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gaining {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' range}}, and dealing {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Ferocity Bonus:}} ''Savagery's'' damage is modified to deal {{pp|35 to 140 for 8; 150 + (240-150)/9*(x-1) for 12|formula = 20 + 15 per level until level 8, then + 10 per level|color=physical damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}. In addition to gaining another instance of the base attack speed on-cast, consuming the attack also grants {{as|{{pp|key=%|50 + (101-50)/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''bonus''' attack speed}} for 5 seconds.

W.name: Battle Roar
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Rengar''' stores 50% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he has taken in the last {{fd|1.5}} seconds as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] on his [[health bar]], increased to 100% of damage taken from {{tip|monsters}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rengar''' roars, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{as|{{pp|65 + (130-65)/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''bonus''' magic damage}} to {{tip|monsters}}, and consuming his [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] to {{tip|heal}} for the same amount.
W.description3: {{sbc|Ferocity Bonus:}} ''Battle Roar's'' damage is modified to deal {{pp|50 + (220-50)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}. '''Rengar''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} himself from all {{tip|crowd control}}.

E.name: Bola Strike
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rengar''' throws a bola in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for {{fd|1.75}} seconds, as well as {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for 2 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} of a 150-unit radius around them for the same duration.
E.description2: {{sbc|Ferocity Bonus:}} ''Bola Strike's'' damage is modified to deal {{pp|50 + (305-50)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=physical damage}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|physical damage}}. The target is {{tip|root|rooted}} instead of {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
E.cast time: {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|While not leaping with Unseen Predator}}|{{tt|None|While leaping with Unseen Predator}}}}

R.name: Thrill of the Hunt
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Rengar''' also gains ''{{ai|Unseen Predator|Rengar}}'' while {{tip|camouflage|camouflaged}} from any source.
R.description2:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Rengar''' prowls for a duration, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. After a 2-second delay, he also becomes {{tip|camouflage|camouflaged}} and gains ''{{ai|Unseen Predator|Rengar}}''.
The camouflage can only last up to 14 seconds. {{bug|2}}
R.leveling2: {{st|Effect Duration|{{ap|12 to 20}} seconds}}{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|40 to 60}}%}}
R.description3: During this time, '''Rengar''' will detect the nearest enemy champion in range, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} and gaining {{tip|sight}} of a 100-unit radius around them. Enemies detected are {{tip|true sight|revealed}} for the remaining full duration.
R.description4: The nearest detected enemy within 1600 range is also marked, alerting all of their allies within 1200 range about '''Rengar's''' presence.
R.description5:
'''Rengar's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{sti|range|icononly=true}} {{ccd|Rengar|range}} range against any enemy or with ''Unseen Predator'' to the marked enemy deals {{as|100% AD}} {{as|'''additional''' physical damage}}, then inflicts {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}} for 4 seconds.
The target is {{tip|true sight|revealed}} until the leap has finished.
R.description6: [[Basic attack|Attacking]] or casting [[champion ability|abilities]] other than ''{{ai|Savagery|Rengar}}'' ends ''Thrill of the Hunt'' immediately.
